question: How are divisions among the many wheels explained without losing unity?
premises: There are many wheels of manifestation.
Each follows its own group or class.
Their divisions are determined through a unity that belongs to each wheel.
inference: Multiplicity among the wheels is organized by class-based unity rather than by absolute separation.
plain_english: Even among those wheels, divisions belonging to each wheel have been determined there by a unity that follows its own group.
